description: Four focused OpenAI Codex Skills for inspectable change, review, project guidance, and setup.

interface.shortDescription: Scoped, evidence-honest engineering for OpenAI Codex.
interface.longDescription: Rootloom is a local, inspectable OpenAI Codex engineering workflow with four public Skills: Change, Review, Project Guidance, and Setup. Governed and Evidence modes load only through Change; optional Project Memory is installed separately.
defaultPrompt: Use Change to route this task as direct, scoped, governed, or evidence-backed work.
Review this change and separate findings from suggested or executed verification.
Seed, refine, or validate concise evidence-backed AGENTS.md guidance.
